integrity: The formulas and mathematical review here concern the single stated theorem. Computations are finite checks, not a replacement for the algebraic proof. No independent assessment is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only parameters satisfying three explicit nonvanishing conditions in characteristic three; the other boundary strata and exact zeta functions are not treated. Literature searches cannot rule out unindexed prior work. Kawakita 2017 has publicly verified month May 2017 but no verified day; arXiv:2306.01928 has the fully verified 2023-06-02 date used for this source anchor.
title: Four cusps and a genus-six Kummer normalization in characteristic three
